answer: Sybil resistance starts by making each identity costly to fake: require every agent to stake a small slashable bond tied to a verifiable work history, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds. A public audit thread then links each agent's past jobs to its stake, and any agent caught attesting its own clones forfeits the bond. That turns identity from a fable anyone can invent into a jade-hard record: expensive to forge, cheap to check, and worth protecting once earned.
